findings.title: Structural root checker accepts corrupted Runtime original-row provenance
findings.description: Fragment registrations verify source hashes; normalized body comparison is implemented only for Core canonical-question rows. In isolated serialized root inventory, change sourceDefinitionHistory[0].oldRowSHA256 for RT-NOVA-REMOTE-SCHEMAVERSION to 64 zeroes, leaving the immutable runtime fragment and its advertised digest unchanged. Full --structural checker returns exit 0 / errorCount 0. The new focused Runtime verifier checks the fragment, not the root projection. Current actual root is exact and correct: this is a persisted-root conservation guard false positive, not observed evidence loss or production bug.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Extend normalized full-row conservation to current Runtime fragment rows at root structural boundary; preserve every original property including sourceDefinitionHistory and correction provenance. Require persisted root-provenance and non-provenance mutations to reject, with unchanged positive controls.
findings.scope: Bounded root Runtime integrity guard; no global semantic/runtime acceptance inferred
